# FlowPane 1.0.5
## New Features
- Added configurable switcher settings. - Added current-application switching in Preview Grid with forward and reverse shortcuts. - Added automatic updates. - Added guided first-run onboarding for permissions and shortcuts.
## Fixes
- Improved screen capture permission handling. - Reduced preview prewarming delays and improved capture timing and reliability. - Improved event-tap and shortcut reliability. - Improved window activation reliability.
## Improvements
- Optimized preview capture performance, concurrency safety, and hardware API usage. - Improved Space compatibility, WindowServer integration, and preview presentation. - Refined onboarding window presentation and application icon masking.
